scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web && npm test -w mcp
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w web && npm run lint -w mcp
